Commentary.Commentary: It promises to be an exciting contest. Do join us in a while for England's reply.

Bangladesh will be mighty disappointed with the way they lost their way. At one stage, it looked like they would reach 350-400 but it didn't happen. Can they make a game of it with the ball? Let's see.

England will be delighted with their effort. From 171/1 they have managed to take the remaining nine wickets for just 49 runs. Moeen Ali and Ben Stokes were the ones who did the most damage taking seven wickets between them.

Mominul followed him after scoring a fifty and Bangladesh lost 5 wickets in the middle session with plenty of soft dismissals as Ben Stokes reverse swung the ball again to trigger a collapse. After Tea, England wasted no time to take the remaining four wickets to bowl Bangladesh out for 220. Moeen finished with figures of 5/57!

Not something new to read if you are a Bangladesh fan! Yet another collapse has probably cost them a Test. Though it is early to say but it could prove to be decisive. They won the toss, elected to bat and were sitting pretty at 171 for 2 before disaster struck. Both Tamim and Mominul were right on top, attacking the England bowlers despite losing Imrul Kayes early. Tamim in particular was very impressive scoring his eighth Test ton but once he fell to Moeen, Bangladesh never recovered.

OUT! FIVE FOR ALI! Flatter outside off, Rabbi comes forward to defend but gets an outside edge that flies to first slip. Root stationed at first slip shows good reflexes to take a sharp catch to his left. He bowled beautifully and truly deserved the fifer. BANGLADESH ALL OUT FOR 220!
Flatter outside off, Rabbi defends it from his crease.
Taijul pushes at one outside off but gets an inside edge through to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Heaved! Full toss on middle, Taijul comes down and swings it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flatter outside off, spins away, Taijul looks to play but is beaten.
Good length outside off, another exaggerated leave by Kamrul.
Woakes goes wide of the crease and bowls it fuller outside off, this time Rabbi hangs his bat out for it but fails to make any contact.
Angled on a fuller length outside off, comes in but not enough to disturb the stumps as Rabbi lets it go through.
Good length outside off, left alone by Rabbi.
Fuller outside off, Kamrul is squared up but does well to keep it out in time.
Angled on a length outside off, Rabbi pays inside the line and is beaten.
Tossed up outside off, spins away, Islam plays all over it and is beaten. Maiden from Moeen!
Floated on middle, defended back down the wicket.
Islam comes forward and defends it with an inside edge towards mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, spins away and beats the outside edge of Islam coming forward.
Islam comes forward and defends it.
Flatter on the pads, Taijul fails to work it through and is hit on his pads. Muted appeal turned down.
Angled on a length, Rabbi tucks it towards the on side.
Good length outside off, left alone by Rabbi.
KAMRUL ISLAM RABBI is the last man in.

OUT! SHAKIB WALKS! Woakes bowls it fuller outside off, Shakib throws his bat at it but can only edge it through to the keeper. The players appeal but Shakib does not wait for the umpire and walks. This is becoming embarrassing for the hosts. They are losing wickets and their grip on the game. England just a wicket away now!
Plays this one with an angled bat towards third man.
On a length on off, Shakib defends it.
On the pads, Shakib works it down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Another on the stumps and is defended by Islam.
Pushes it to covers off his crease.
Floated on off, Islam comes forward and defends it.
TAIJUL ISLAM walks in to bat. The lights are on at the stadium!

OUT! Good call to review, Cook! Fuller on middle and leg, Mehedi looks to sweep but fails to connect and is hit on his pads. The players go up in an appeal but the umpire is unmoved. That was too full, the only question is where the ball pitched. Cook goes for the review after consulting Ali. The replays show that there was no bat involved. Three reds and Mehedi has to go back.
England have taken a review against Mehedi. Cook is confident.
Shorter on middle, Mehedi looks to clip but does not get it past Cook at leg slip. Cook almost hung onto a stunner.
Floated outside off, Mehedi comes forward and defends it.
Back of a length outside off, Shakib looks to pull but is hit on his body.
On a length on off, Mehedi defends it with an inside edge through backward square leg for a single.
This one is left alone by Mehedi.
Back of a length on off, Mehedi defends it from his crease.
MEHEDI HASAN is the new man in.

OUT! Loose shot! Fuller outside off, Hom drives at it from his crease but only manages to edge it to the keeper Bairstow who takes a good low catch going to his right. Early wicket for England and Bangladesh are seven down!
It has gone a bit dark at the stadium.
Shorter length on off, Shakib pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Hom comes forward and defends it.
FOUR! Take that! Hom gets under this one and clobbers it wide of mid off for a boundary.
Edged! Dropped! Shortish outside off, Hom hits it hard to Ballance at short leg. The ball goes off his left leg and falls away. That was a tough chance!
On the pads, Hom fails to clip it through. Short leg collects and appeals but there was no bat there.
Floated outside off, Hom comes forward and looks to defend but is beaten.
Fuller on off, Shakib works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
MOEEN ALI to bowl from the other end. Two slips in place for him, the long off is up.
Angled on a fuller length outside off, pushed to covers by Hom.
Good length outside off, Hom defends it towards covers.
Hom works it towards the on side off his crease.
Spears in full on off, kept out by Hom.
Works it down to leg side for a single.
Begins with a good length on off, Shakib defends it.

Welcome back for the final session of play! SHAKIB AL HASAN and SHUVAGATA HOM are out to bat. There are still 34 overs left in the day. Will see a rearguard from Bangladesh from here on or will England wrap this up and get batting today itself? Let's see. England begin the session with CHRIS WOAKES...
...DAY 1...SESSION 3...

England will want to wrap this up early but will the hosts allow that to happen? The hosts will hope Shakib can take them to a safe score here. What is a safe score though? Let's see. Do join us for the final session of play in a while.

Mahmudullah's stay at the crease was a short one as Stokes sent him back to the hut with a good delivery. Ali continued his brilliant display of spin bowling by removing Rahim to bag his third. Stokes then struck again to get rid of Rahman. The match is poised nicely at the moment and the pitch is offering good assistance to the spinners. There is some reverse swing on offer as well.

What a session for England! The hosts have lost their way as five wickets fell for just 87 runs. A brilliant session for England as they have pushed Bangladesh on the back foot after a dominating start. Tamim and Mominul started the session in an attacking manner and were scoring at a fair clip. Tamim completed his 8th Test century but fell just after that to Moeen Ali. The latter also departed in quick succession as he was completely beaten by pace and got bowled to Ali. England clawed back into the contest as the pair was looking threatening.
Landed around off, Hom defends it towards short leg and that is TEA, DAY 1!
EDGED! Flatter outside off, comes in with the spin, Hom looks to defend but gets an edge. Muted appeal turned down.
Landed outside off, turns in, Hom defends it.
The pressure tells on Hom! Fuller on middle, Hom goes for the heave, gets it over mid-wicket for a couple.
Floated on middle, Hom looks to work it through but does not connect well. Replays show there was an inside edge there.
Fuller on middle, worked towards fine leg for a single. Hom now has 5 balls to face before Tea, not ideal perhaps?
Hom comes forward and defends it.
Ohhh! Fuller length on off, keeps low, Hom keeps it out in time.
Angled in on a fuller length outside off, Hom pushes at it and is beaten all ends up.
SHUVAGATA HOM comes out to bat.

OUT! BANGLADESH ARE AT IT! Good length outside off, coming in with the angle, pitches and moves away ever so slightly. Rahman cannot stop himself from poking at it and only manages to edge it through to the keeper who dives to his right to take the catch. This is a brilliant session of play for the visitors. Stokes has again done the damage!
Shakib guides this one down to third man for a single with a late dab.
On a length on off, Shakib comes forward and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Sabbir comes forward and blocks it. A wicket maiden for Ali!
Floated outside off, Sabbir stays back and defends it.
Flatter on off, kept out by Rahman.
Rahman keeps it out in time.
Floated outside off, Sabbir comes forward and defends it.
SABBIR RAHMAN is the new man in.

OUT! Oh dear, Bangladesh! Floated on middle, Rahim comes down the track to work it through mid-wicket. The ball goes off the inside edge and flies through his legs to Alastair Cook at leg slip who gets a hand to it, the ball bounces off it onto his chest and Cook holds onto it on the third attempt. There is pindrop silence in the stadium and that tells you how important that wicket was for England. Third wicket for Ali!
Stokes has a chat with Rahim if he is okay. That looked nasty.
EDGED! Good length outside off, Rahim pokes at it and gets it down to third man for a single.

Mushfiqur Rahim has been hit on the helmet and is down. The physio attends to him and the English players are concerned too. Gets up and the crowd cheers for him. That was a hard blow and it is good to see that everything is fine.

OUCH! Banged in short outside off, comes in a long way, Rahim takes his eyes off that one as he looks to leave it getting out of the line but is hit on his helmet. The keeper collects but the players hurry towards Rahim who is down on his back. Rahim looked to duck but the inward movement caught him by surprised and it hit him at the back of his head. His parents are out in the crowd watching him in the middle, that's not a good sight for anyone to be honest.
Good length outside off, Rahim defends it towards gully off his crease.
Fuller outside off, Rahim comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Angled on a fuller length outside off, Rahim comes forward to defend but is beaten.
Back of a length on middle, Rahim stands tall and defends it.
Lunges across and defends it towards short leg.
Floated on off, Shakib comes forward and defends it.
Rahim slinks down the wicket and drives it to sweeper cover for three runs.
Shorter on off, Rahim stays back and defends it.

Spun too much? High? Flatter on middle, Rahim looks to work it through but is hit on his pads. The players go up in an appeal but the umpire says no. May be it was too high. Replays show it was missing leg. Good call.
Drives it through mid off for a single.
On a good length wide outside off, left alone by Rahim.
Back of a length ball again, Rahim guides it towards the man at gully.
MUSHFIQUR RAHIM is the new batsman.

OUT! Hits the deck hard and gets the reward! On a good length outside off, nipping away a bit. Mahmudullah looks to run it down to third man but only get a thick outside edge that carries to Cook at first slip and he pouches it safely. The English side are chipping in with the wickets and coming back into the contest!
This one is bowled on the pads on a shorter length, Shakib gloves it down to fine leg for a single.
Similar length, similar shot and similar result. No run.
Back of a length on off, comes in a touch, Shakib pushes it towards point with a dab.
Flatter on the pads, Mahmudullah fails to work it off his pads.
Floated outside off, Shakib pushes it to mid off for a single.
Outside off, Shakib comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Fuller on off, Shakib comes forward and drives it back down the wicket.
Short again, Shakib cuts it towards covers.
Shorter on off, keeps a touch low, Shakib keeps it out off his back foot.
Fuller outside off, Mahmudullah comes forward and defends it.
Banged in short on middle and leg, Mahmudullah sits under it and lets it go.
Slanted on a length on middle, Mahmudullah looks to work it through mid-wicket but gets opened up a bit and manages to keep it out back down the wicket.
Good length outside off, no shot offered.
A tad short outside off, comes in, Mahmudullah rides the bounce and pushes it towards the off side.
Back of a length outside off, Mahmudullah comes forward and defends it.
Shorter outside off, spins away, Shakib plays it with the spin towards covers.
Fuller outside off, driven to mid off but the bowler goes to his right and stops the ball.
Plays this one back to the bowler.
Shakib gets in line and defends it.
Bowls the arm ball outside off, spins away, Shakib comes forward to defend but fails to put bat to ball.
Floated on middle, Shakib comes forward and defends it.
Angled in on a length outside off, swings in sharply but way after Mahmudullah has left it.
Fuller outside off, left alone by Mahmudullah.
FOUR! SHOT! Fuller outside off, Mahmudullah plays it wide of mid off covering the swing. That was a touch too full and Mahmudullah made the most of it.
On a length outside off, swings away late, Mahmudullah lets it go through.
On a good length outside off, Mahmudullah looks to play at first but withdraws his bat in time.
EDGED! This is a good period of play for England! Hurled in a on a length outside off, Mahmudullah pushes at it and gets it towards gully on the bounce.
Flatter on middle, turns away, Shakib goes back and keeps it out in time.
Spins this one away from Shakib who is beaten by the turn.
Fuller outside off, Shakib comes forward and defends it.
SHAKIB AL HASAN is the new man in. Bangladesh need him to stitch a partnership here.

OUT! That was coming! Ali was troubling him and Bangladesh have lost two quickly. Bowls the arm ball outside off, comes in and Mominul is on his back foot looking to defend but is beaten by pace. The ball crashes into the stumps going through the gap between the bat and pad. That is a vital wicket for Moeen and England are coming back in the game.
Fuller on off, driven towards mid off by Mominul.
Close! Floated outside off, holds its line, Mominul lets it go through but that was very close to the off stump.
Another leave for Mahmudullah.
Good length on off, Mahmudullah works it towards mid-wicket off his crease.
Back of a length on off, tucked towards the on side.
Hurls it on a length outside off, another leave.
On a length outside off, left alone.
REVERSE! Good length outside off, Mahmudullah looks to defend from his crease but is beaten by the away swing.
BEN STOKES comes back on for a spell.
Comes forward and Haque defends it with an outside edge towards point.
FOUR LEG BYES! Slanted down the leg side, Haque fails to sweep that one. The ball runs down to the fine leg fence off the pads. Leg byes signaled and Moeen has his hand covering his face.
Shorter outside off, cut to covers.
Tossed up on off, Haque comes forward and defends it.
Floated outside off, Mahmudullah comes forward and defends it with an edge behind square leg for a single.
Floated on middle, Mominul looks to drive but does off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
DRINKS BREAK!
SIX! THAT'S HAMMERED!  Full delivery, Mahmudullah comes forward and launches onto it. The ball clears the long on boundary easily.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Tossed up outside off, Mahmudullah pushes at it but gets an outside edge that falls just short of first slip.
Short outside off, Haque pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.

AN APPEAL FOR LBW TURNED DOWN! Tossed up on middle and leg, spinning in. Haque misses his flick shot and is rapped on the pads. The English side appeal but in vain. The replays show that it would have probably going down leg.
Mahmudullah drives it with the spin through covers for a single.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
Haque comes forward to defend but is beaten by the ball spinning away.
FOUR! SHOT! Short ball, Haque rocks back and pulls it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Outside off, driven back towards the bowler.
Tossed up on leg stump, Mahmudullah gets an inside edge that falls just in front of leg gully. Single taken.
MAHMUDULLAH is the new man in. Lot of fielders close in for him.

OUT! TAMIM DEPARTS AFTER A BRILLIANT CENTURY! Pushed quicker through the air, coming in with the arm. Iqbal pads it away. There is a huge appeal for LBW and the umpire rules it out. Tamim takes a review after consulting with Mominul. The impact doesn't matter as Iqbal didn't offer any stroke on that one. The Hawk Eye shows that it would have clipped the off stump. Hence, the on-field call stays. Good breakthrough for the English side.
Oh dear! Tamim is given out lbw looking to pad one away. Dharamasena thinks it is out. Tamim has reviewed it though. Let's see.
Googly again around leg, Iqbal comes forward to defend but gets an outside edge past slip. Three runs taken as the ball went to the deep.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Slips in a googly, Tamim prods forward to defend but is beaten all ends up.
Driven back towards the bowler.
On middle, worked down the leg side.
Bye! Going down leg, Haque leaves it and Bairstow also fails to collect it. Bye taken.
Tossed up outside off, Iqbal pads it away. There is an appeal for LBW but the umpire shakes his head.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
8th Test hundred for Tamim Iqbal.

FOUR! What a shot! Comes in with the arm from around off, Iqbal comes down the track and lifts it over the covers for a boundary. 100 up for Iqbal and it has been a superb knock. Take a bow Tamim and the crowd acknowledges his batting display.
FOUR! Iqbal dances down to the flighted delivery and plays it inside out and the ball races to the boundary. Moves on to 97.
Tossed up outside off, Iqbal comes ahead and blocks.
Tossed up outside off, Iqbal looks to drive but gets a bottom edge towards the leg side.
Slips in a googly this time, Haque looks to defend but is beaten.
Floated up outside off, Haque looks to play a free flowing drive but only gets a bottom edge that rolls down the pitch.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Haque nudges it behind square leg for a single.
Haque drives it with the spin towards mid on.
Full on leg stump, swept down to fine leg for a single.
On a length, spinning away sharply. Haque leaves it alone.
Mominul presses forward and blocks.
Outside off, Haque plays it towards point.
Haque looks to flick it against the spin but gets a leading edge down the pitch.
Floated outside off, driven towards short cover.
Going down leg, Tamim flicks it towards square leg and scurries through for a quick single. There is a throw at the striker's end but Mominul was safely in.
MOEEN ALI comes back into the attack.
Flighted delivery around off, driven wide of mid off for a single.
Floated up around leg stump, going down. Iqbal lets it through.
Loopy ball outside leg, defended towards short mid-wicket.
Slips in a googly this time, Tamim picks it up and defends solidly off the front foot.
Loopy ball around leg stump, Iqbal clips it gently towards short mid-wicket.
Pushed quicker through the air on off, Tamim is up to it as he stays back and defends.
Fullish ball on off, driven towards mid on.
150-run stand up for Mominul and Tamim.
FOUR! More frustation for England. Similar delivery, this time Haque gets a thick outside edge that runs down to the third man boundary.
Comes around the wicket and bowls it very full outside off, Mominul looks to squeeze it but misses. There is a loud appeal but in vain. It was more out of frustration.
Back of a length ball around middle and leg, Tamim swivels across and pulls it down to fine leg for a single. Moves on to 89.
FOUR! BEAUTIFUL SHOT! Fullish ball around middle and off, Tamim waits for it and clips it deftly wide of Root at mid on and the ball whistles away to the boundary.
Full length ball outside off, Iqbal commits to the drive but gets beaten.
On a length, spinning away. Haque stays back and withdraws to play at it. The ball hits him on the thigh pad and the keeper catches it. There is an appeal but in vain.
Loopy ball on middle, Haque gets an inside edge onto his pads. There is a stifled appeal for LBW but the umpire shakes his head.
Shortish ball outside off, Iqbal gets a thick outside edge through the slip region. Three runs taken.
Quicker one on middle, Iqbal stays back and defends.
Haque works it with the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
Leg-spinner outside off, spinning in. Mominul looks to defend off his back foot but misses and is rapped on the pads. Muted appeal for LBW turned down.
Full around middle and leg, clipped nicely wide of mid on for a brisk couple.
BEATEN! Similar delivery, Iqbal looks to drive on  the up but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
This one angles away after pitching. Iqbal watches it closely and lets it through.
On a length and straight, Iqbal drives it back to the bowler.
Full length ball outside off, Iqbal lunges and drills it towards mid on where Root dives athletically to his right to save a certain boundary.
Back of a length ball at the stumps, nudged down the leg side for a single.
Going down leg, tucked through square leg for a single.
Tossed up around middle, Haque defends it towards the leg side.
This one spins in sharply from outside off, Haque goes back and looks to play at it but misses and is struck on the thigh pad.
Lands it on a length on leg stump, Haque misses his flick shot and is rapped on the pads. Muted appeal for LBW turned down!
Similar ball, Haque leaves it this time.
Loopy leg-spinner going down leg, Haque looks to flick it but misses.
Iqbal punches it towards covers.
Fuller length ball outside off, Iqbal comes forward to drive but gets it off the inner half of his bat towards the leg side.
On a good length going across Tamim. He comes on the front foot and cuts it straight to the man at point.
Fullish ball around middle and off, Iqbal comes forward and defends.
FOUR! TAMIM IS IN THE ZONE! Shortish delivery around off, Iqbal camps back and pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length ball angling across, Haque gets it off the outer half of his bat behind point for a single.
The batsman plays the Square cut. They pick up a single.
10th Test fifty for Mominul Haque!
FOUR! SHOT! Tossed up delivery, Haque lifts it over the bowler's head and the ball races to the fence.
Pushed quicker through the air outside off, Iqbal opes the face of the bat and guides it to third man. Three runs taken. 50 up for Mominul and it has been an impressive knock.

DROPPED! Bowls a loopy delivery outside off, Iqbal goes for a full fledged drive but gets an outside edge that goes towards the keeper quickly. He fails on to grab on to that one. It was a difficult chance though.
Too straight this time, Iqbal clips it to fine leg for a couple.
Full at the stumps, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
On a length outside off, defended to the covers.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Iqbal stands up on his toes and pulls it in front of square for a single. A bit of Lara touch on that shot!
On a good length outside off, Iqbal stays back and defends down the pitch.
WELL BOWLED! Shortish delivery angling away, Iqbal looks to run it down  but is surprised a bit with the extra bounce. Fends it off on the pitch.
On a length arond middle, angles away a bit. Tamim stays back and defends. Good channel this!
Overpitched outside off, Tamim leans forward and drives it nicely but fails to pierce the gap.
STEVEN FINN to bowl from the other end.
Haque stays back and punches it with the spin towards mid on.
Full on middle, defended down the pitch.
Tossed up outside off, Haque comes forward and drives it upplishly through the covers. Ben Duckett in the deep puts in a good effort to save a boundary.
On a length and at the stumps, Haque stays back and defends.
Leg-spinner on leg stump, nudged round the corner for a single.
Down the leg side, Tamim looks to tickle it but misses.
Welcome back for the second session of play! The players are back in the middle. TAMIM IQBAL and MOMINUL HAQUE will continue their innings. ADIL RASHID will continue his spell.
...DAY 1...SESSION 2...

England after the blitzkrieg, as usual followed the ball quite a bit and will want to keep the runs down since the wicket already has a lot of cracks and they will not want to concede too many early in the game. They will look for more control while the hosts will want to continue the good work and build on this platform by Tamim and Mominul. Do join us for the second session in a while.

What a start to the 2nd Test! Wicket, runs and a lot of action! Winning the toss and electing to bat, Bangladesh lost Imrul Kayes early and Tamim Iqbal looked like a nervous duck. But once he got off the mark, runs flowed for him as he raced away from 0 in 19 balls to registering his fifty in 60 balls as Bangladesh went hard against the England spinners. Tamim slowed down a touch towards the end but Mominul then took up the mantle to take on the England bowling.
Bowls it full outside off, Mominul goes for a full fledged drive but only manages to drag an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls towards the leg side. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Fullish delivery on off, Haque pushes it gently towards cover-point.
On a length around off, Haque camps back and punches it towards the covers.
Fullish ball around middle, played towards mid-wicket for a single.
GOOD BOUNCER hurled in quick! Dug in short just outside off, Iqbal drops his wrists and sways away from the line nicely.
Bowls a shortish delivery outside off, Iqbal camps back and defends.
FOUR! WELL PLAYED! Overpitched around off, Haque comes forward and drives it beautifully through the covers for a boundary.
Tossed up around off, spinning in. Haque kneels and sweeps it round the corner for a couple. Muted appeal for an LBW turned down.
Iqbal plays it with the spin behind square for a single.
Quicker one again, Haque camps back and works it down the leg side for a single.
Slips in a googly this time and bowls it quicker around off, spinning away. Haque stays back and defends.
Slow through the air on off, Haque lunges forward and defends.
Sprays it down the leg side this time, Iqbal looks to flick it but misses.
In between full and good length around off, Iqbal leans forward and pushes it confidently towards the cover region.
Bowls it fullish this time around off, Iqbal comes forward and defends it towards covers.
Delay in the game as Tamim gets some medical attention. The physio has him back up and ready to play.

OUCH! THAT MUST HAVE HURT! Dug in short outside off, angling in from around the wicket. Iqbal is caught in an awkward position as he looks to fend it but misses and the ball hits him right in the rib cage area. Seems to be in real pain here!
Sprayed down the leg side, Iqbal looks to clip it but misses.

NOT OUT! GOOD REVIEW BY TAMIM! Bowls a shortish delivery around the rib cage area, going down. Tamim is cramed up a bit as he looks to glide it towards fine leg but seems to have missed it and the ball goes through to the keeper. Bairstow catches it and goes up for an appeal. The umpire obliges and rules it out. Tamim is confident and takes a review straightaway. The replays show that there was no bat on that one and it only brushed the thigh pad. Hence, the on-field call is overturned and iqbal survives!
Tamim is given out caught down the leg side, he is confident that he has not hit that one and reviews it rightaway.
Tossed up around middle ad leg, spins away a bit. Nudged behind square for a single.
Bowls it fuller on off this time, Iqbal lunges forward and pushes it to the covers.
Similar length and around middle and leg, Mominul pulls it through square leg for a single.
Shortish delivery on leg stump, Iqbal tucks it round the corner for a single.
Drags his length back, Iqbal covers the line and defends solidly.
Tossed up and full at the stumps, defended towards mid on.
As expected, ADIL RASHID comes on for a bowl.

On a length on leg stump, Iqbal looks to flick but only manages to get an inside edge onto his pads which rolls down the leg side, Single taken. Bangladesh have raced to 106 only in 24 overs. Great start for the home side.
Adil Rashid is warming up!
Straying on the pads, nudged round the corner for a single.
Comes around the wicket and bowls it at the stumps, Haque covers the line and defends solidly.
Fuller length ball on off, driven nicely towards the covers for a single.
Fullish ball at the stumps, flicked nicely through mid-wicket for a couple.
Fullish ball around off, Iqbal lunges forward and defends down the pitch.
A tad short on the stumps, Haque hangs back and defends.
100-run stand up between Tamim and Mominul!
Comes around the wicket and bowls it fullish on middle, Iqbal clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
100 UP FOR BANGLADESH! Haque plays with the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Haque presses forward and defends.
Haque flicks it towards the leg side with the spin.
FOUR! LOOSE DELIVERY AND IT GETS THE TREATMENT! Juicy full toss outside off, Haque comes forward and dispatches it through backward point and the ball races to the fence.
Full length ball on off, driven back towards covers. Maiden for Stokes and it was a very good over.
Dug in short, angling away. Iqbal first looks to pull but then decides not to as he leaves it alone.
Iqbal drives the full length ball towards mid on.

A STIFLED APPEAL FOR LBW TURNED DOWN! Pitched outside leg, Iqbal looks to flick but misses and is hit on the knee roll. The English side appeal in unison but in vain. The replays confirm that it pitched outside leg.
Fuller length ball just outside off, Iqbal comes forward and blocks.
On a length, angling across. Iqbal plays it towards the fielder at point.
Going down leg, Haque lets it go through.
A tad shorter this time, Haque stays back and defends towards short leg.
Haque drives it with the spin through mid on for a single.
FOUR! GOOD SHOT! Too full outside off, Haque leans forward and creams it through covers for an exquisite boundary.
On a length outside off, spinning in sharply. Iqbal stays back and chops it behind point for a single.
FOUR! DEFT FROM IQBAL! Bowls it on middle, Iqbal comes forward and takes it on the full. Paddles it very fine and the ball races to the fine leg fence.
This time he flirts with it and gets beaten! On a length, angling away. Haque pokes at it but gets beaten.
GOOD DELIVERY! Similar length angling across and leaving the left hander. He watches it closely and does not flirt with it.
Good length ball on off, Haque covers the line and defends down the ground.
Haque pulls the shortish delivery towards mid on.
Similar delivery, bounces a bit more this time. Haque stays back and defends it towards the off side.
On a length angling across Mominul. He stands tall and pushes it towards cover-point.
BEN STOKES into the attack now! Root, Finn and Stokes have a chat. England will want to him to bring some control back for them.
Loopy delivery on off, Iqbal comes forward and blocks it into the ground.
Full delivery around off, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Mominul drives it with the spin through mid on for a single.
On a length, spinning in. Haque looks to nudge it round the corner but misses and the ball hits him on the rib cage and rolls down the pitch. Turn and bounce on offer for Ansari.
Haque stays back and defends towards short leg.
On a length, spinning in. Tamim camps back and punches it to mid on for a single.
Full on middle and off, Haque presses forward and blocks.
Going down leg this time, helped on its way down to fine leg for a couple.
Loopy ball on off this time, Haque puts his head down and defends solidly.
Full on middle and leg, Mominul comes forward and defends nicely to short leg.
A tad short outside off, Iqbal plays it through point for a single.
Full delivery around off, driven back towards the bowler.
Full outside off, driven towards covers but fails to find the gap.
On a length, spinning in. Iqbal stays back and defends it towards short mid-wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Bowls it down the leg side, Tamim looks to sweep but misses.
Flighted delivery, Iqbal comes forward and defends.
Iqbal misses out this time. Iqbal goes for the sweep but only manages to get it down the pitch.
Loopy delivery around off, Mominul comes forward and defends down the pitch.
FOUR! AGGRESSIVE INTENT FROM HAQUE! Bowls it fullish on off, Haque extends his arms and lifts it over mid on for a gorgeous boundary.
A tad short outside off, Iqbal rocks back and punches it to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Iqbal presses forward and blocks.
Fractionally short outside off, Haque cuts it towards point for a single.
Haque works it with the spin round the corner for a couple. The ball is already turning quite a bit.
A bit slower through the air, Haque leans forward and drives it through the covers for a single.
Mominul presses forward and blocks.
Full outside off, driven back towards the bowler.
Haque comes down the track but only manages to get a thick inside edge onto his pads.
20th Test fifty for Tamim Iqbal!

Similar delivery, Iqbal kneels and paddles it round the corner and the ball runs towards fine leg. Three runs taken. With that, its 50 up for Iqbal and it has been a good innings. He would like to carry on.
Full delivery around off, spins in. Mominul gets it from the inner half of his bat towards short fine leg for a single.
DRINKS BREAK!

NOT OUT! ENGLAND LOSE A REVIEW! Loud appeal for lbw! Floated outside off, Tamim comes forward but pads it away. There is a loud appeal for an lbw. Cook wants the review after a conference with Bairstow and Ali. The replays show that the ball was missing the stumps by quite a distance. Good decision, Dharmasena after having a very rough first Test.
England have taken a review against Tamim Iqbal. It is regarding an LBW decision.

Tossed up outside off, Tamim looks to chop it but it is too close to the stumps. Loud appeal from the keeper but bat first reckons the bowler. The replays show it was bat first, good call to not review.
Tamim comes forward and defends it.
Bowled outside off, Tamim looks to work it through the on side but then adjusts well to defend it to covers.
TURN! Tamim stays back to work it down the ground but gets it off the edge down to third man for a brace.
RIPPER! Bowls it on middle, spins away, Tamim stays back and looks to defend but fails to put to bat to ball.
Change of ends for MOEEN ALI.
Pushes this one through mid on for a single. An expensive start to Test cricket for Ansari but an eventful one.

FOUR! Runs are flowing for Bangladesh! Tamim comes down and drives it back down the wicket. First the bowler dives to his left but cannot stop it, Woakes at mid off then dives but cannot stop the ball despite getting a hand to it. Another boundary, Bangladesh are not allowing Zafar to settle.
FOUR! Clear intent from Tamim! Floated outside off, Tamim slinks down the wicket and places it nicely through covers for a boundary. Moeen Ali gives it a chase but comes second best.
Mominul drives it through mid off for a single. Finn has a shy at the non-strikers' end but misses.
Almost a wicket! Bowls it on middle, Tamim looks to defend but gets a leading edge which flies past a diving Joe Root at first slip. Three runs taken but that was really close!
Begins with a fuller one outside off, played back to the bowler.

Right then, time for the debutant! ZAFAR ANSARI to bowl. Interesting that Cook has gone to the left-arm spinner despite two left handed batsmen batting. Cook has a chat with his bowler. A slip and a short leg in place.
Works this one through backward square leg for a single. 13 runs from the over.
50-run partnership up for Tamim and Mominul.
FOUR! EVEN BETTER FROM TAMIM! Short from Woakes, Tamim is waiting for it and pummels it through mid-wicket. There was no intent to keep it down. This is superb cricket and a nice little contest!
Nice comeback from Woakes! Spears the yorker on off, Tamim digs it out in time. Good cricket!
FOUR! Wow, Tamim! Back of a length outside off, Tamim comes forward and punches it brilliantly through covers. That was superbly timed.
Fuller outside off, Tamim comes forward and drives it to mid off.
Square leg goes back. Chris Woakes also switches his angle to around the wicket.
FOUR! Nicely done! Fuller on middle, too full in fact, Tamim clips it nicely through mid-wicket for a boundary. That was nicely timed.
Drives this one towards mid off but not in the gap.
Haque comes forward and defends it.
Bowls a full toss on middle, Tamim comes forward and clips it nicely through mid-wicket. Adil Rashid gives it a chase and slides to keep the ball in play. Three runs taken.
Fuller on off, Haque drives it hard towards covers for a single.
Floated outside off, Haque comes forward and defends it.
FOUR LEG BYES! Bowls it down the leg side, Haque fails to clip it through and the keeper misses it as well. The ball runs down to fine leg fence. The umpire signals it leg byes for some reason.
FOUR! EMPHATIC! Dug in short outside off, Iqbal picks it early and smashes it through mid-wicket for a boundary. That was hit with a lot of disdain.
Bowls this one on off, Iqbal comes forward and defends it.
Sprays it full but is very wide outside off, no shot offered from Tamim.
Another cutter from Woakes, pushed down the wicket by Tamim off his crease.
Fuller outside off, left alone by Tamim.
On a length outside off, Tamim looks to cut it but is beaten. The cutter does not carry to the keeper.
Change of ends for CHRIS WOAKES!
Shorter outside off, Tamim rides the bounce and plays it towards point for a single.
FOUR! VINTAGE TAMIM! Fuller outside off, Tamim shimmies down the wicket and slams it through covers. That raced away to the fence.
On the pads, Mominul does not connect with his sweep. The ball goes down to fine leg off the pads for a leg bye.
Fuller on middle, Mominul comes forward and defends it.
Fuller on off, pushed back down the wicket.
Floated on off, turns away a touch, Haque pushes inside the line and is beaten.
Fuller on off, Iqbal drives it back down the wicket, Finn does well in his followthrough to stop that one.
Good length outside off, Tamim comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
Fuller outside off, Tamim drives it nicely to covers. Ali dives and stops the ball. He deflects it towards mid off but no runs taken.
Back of a length on middle, Tamim tucks it through square leg for a couple of runs.
Fuller outside off, Tamim comes forward and defends it.
Fuller outside off, left alone by Tamim.
Change of gloves for Tamim. Two slips in place now for Finn, compared to three when the game began.
Bowls it on the pads, worked towards square leg by Mominul.
Shorter on middle, turns away from Tamim a touch who plays it through covers for a single.
Tamim comes forward and defends it.
Fuller on middle, Tamim drives it towards mid off.
Fuller on off, played back down the wicket by Tamim.
Floated on middle, Tamim comes forward and nudges it towards the on side.
TIME FOR SPIN! MOEEN ALI into the attack early!
FOUR! Shot of the morning, says Mike Atherton on air and rightly so! Fuller outside off, Mominul gets nicely forward and caresses it through mid off for a boundary.

More like this Tamim! Shorter length on middle, Tamim drags it through mid-wicket just wide of Ballance at short leg who shook a bit watching Tamim swivel a touch. Zafar Ansari gives it a chase from mid-wicket and keeps them down to three.
Tamim comes forward and defends this.

Nice stop! Fuller outside off, Tamim comes forward and pushes it through point with a drive. Duckett gets to his right and dives to get a hand to it. That slows down the ball and they get a couple of runs. Tamim is off the mark after 19 balls!
Back of a length on off, Iqbal defends it from his crease.
Length outside off, left alone by Tamim.

FOUR! Deft and that is how Kayes should have played the short one! On a length outside off, Mominul stands back and places it nicely through the gap between the slips and gully for a boundary. Was not where he intended but was in the gap nevertheless.
Fuller outside off, Haque drives it to mid off.

FOUR! The sparse crowd is alive and that should tell you it is something good for the hosts! Fuller ball on the pads, Mominul clips it nicely through mid-wicket for a boundary. He gets off the mark in fine fashion!
FLASH  AND A MISS! On a good length outside off, Haque throws his bat at it but cannot connect.
Slanted full and wide outside off, Mominul is not interested.
Back of a length on off, Haque defends it with a horizontal bat towards covers.
On a length outside off, Tamim comes forward and pushes it to covers. 17 balls for no runs for him so far!
Fuller outside off, this time Tamim is right forward and defends it nicely.
Back of a length outside off, Tamim defends it towards the off side.
On a length on off, Tamim is not certain and defends it towards short leg with a nervous dab.
Fuller on middle, Tamim comes forward to defend but does so with an inside edge. The ball falls wide of the fielder at short leg. Finn has his hands on his head.
Good length outside off, swings away a touch, Tamim watches it swing and carefully opens the face of the bat to push it towards point.
On a length outside off, left alone again.
Another patient leave from Mominul.
Slanted across on a fuller length, another leave.
On a length outside off, left alone by Mominul.
MOMINUL HAQUE is the new man in.

OUT! KAYES DEPARTS! What a way to lose your Test wicket! Short and wide outside off, asking to be hit. Kayes though hits it too well but straight to Ben Duckett at point who takes a good leaping catch. Kayes cannot believe his luck, he would back himself to hit that one to the fence 11 out of 10 times but not today. That is a perfect start for the visitors.
Back of a length on middle, Kayes gets on top of it and tucks it down towards short leg. Nicely played there, Kayes took the bottom hand off the bat in time there.
On a length outside off, Tamim plays inside the line and lets it go through.
Fuller outside off, another mistimed drive from Tamim.
A touch short on middle, Tamim is not sure whether to play at it or leave at first, ends up raising his arms to let it through.
Slanted down the leg side, left alone by Tamim.

On a length outside off, Tamim comes forward to defend but fails to put bat to ball. The keeper collects and wonders if there was an edge. The slips are confident of an edge and appeal but to no avail.
Bowls a full toss outside off, Imrul looks to drive it hard through covers but fails to connect and ends up getting it towards square leg for a single to get off the mark!
STEVEN FINN to bowl from the other end.
What an over! Tamim looks to smash this short one outside off, way over point but fails to make contact. Eventful start to the Test!
On a length on middle, Tamim awkwardly defends it towards the on side.

JAFFA! Bowls it on a length on off and middle, Tamim looks to play at it from his crease and is beaten by the late swing into him. This one carries through nicely to Bairstow. That's a peach to begin with!
Pitched up outside off, Tamim comes forward to defend but does so off the inner half of the bat.
Doesn't carry! Slanted on a length outside off, Tamim plays inside the line and is beaten. The ball barely carries to the keeper.
Fuller and outside off, left alone by Tamim.

We are all ready to kickstart the first session. The players walk out in the middle. Tamim Iqbal and Imrul Kayes will open the batting for the home side. Chris Woakes will start the proceedings for England. Three slips and a gully in place. Here we go...
England XI - Alastair Cook(c), Ben Duckett, Joe Root, Gary Ballance, Ben Stokes, Moeen Ali, Jonny Bairstow(wk), Zafar Ansari, Chris Woakes, Adil Rashid, Steven Finn.
Bangladesh XI - Tamim Iqbal, Imrul Kayes, Mominul Haque, Mahmudullah, Mushfiqur Rahim(wk/c), Shakib Al Hasan, Sabbir Rahman, Shuvagata Hom, Mehedi Hasan, Taijul Islam, Kamrul Islam Rabbi.

TOSS - BANGLADESH WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BAT. A solitary change for Bangladesh as Shafiul Islam is replaced by Shuvagata Hom. A couple of changes for the visitors. ZAFAR ANSARI was handed his Test cap earlier by England's batting coach Mark Ramprakash. Gareth Batty is the unfortunate one to miss out. Steven Finn has been brought in for Stuart Broad!

Hello and a warm welcome on Day 1 of the second Test between Bangladesh and England. It was a thriller of a match at Chittagong and the visitors came out on top. The home side would be eager to prove a point and come back hard in the final test. It has been raining at Dhaka for the previous two days and rain is forecast for the next three days. Let's hope the rain gods stay merciful and we are treated to some riveting action again. The track is expected to be dry once more and spinners would come into play big time.
